info.title: ZIA Cloud Service and Sandbox Submission APIs
info.description: API Reference Guide for the ZIA Cloud Service and Sandbox Submission APIs

get.description: Retrieves the list of all PAC files which are in deployed state. This list includes default and custom PAC files. To learn more, see About Hosted PAC Files.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Returns PAC files with the names that match the search criteria

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Retrieves the list of PAC files without the PAC file content in the response

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: Specifies the page size. The default size is 100.

post.description:
Adds a new custom PAC file. To learn more about PAC file configuration, see Using Custom PAC Files to Forward Traffic to ZIA and Writing a PAC File.

Note: Before adding a new PAC file, you can validate the content of the PAC file by sending a POST request to /pacFiles/validate. This request only adds a PAC file. The PAC file needs to be transitioned to the Deploy state in order for the file to be deployed.

parameters.name: body
parameters.description: PAC object that defines PAC file to be created

post.description: Sends the PAC file content for validation and returns the validation result. To learn more, see Using Custom PAC Files to Forward Traffic to ZIA.

delete.description: Deletes an existing PAC file including all of its versions based on the specified ID

parameters.name: pacId
parameters.description: Specifies the ID of the PAC file

get.description: Retrieves all versions of a PAC file based on the specified ID

parameters.name: pacId
parameters.description: Specifies the ID of the PAC file

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Excludes specific information about the PAC file from the response such as the PAC file content

post.description: Adds a new PAC file version by branching an existing version based on the specified ID. To learn more, see Using Custom PAC Files to Forward Traffic to ZIA.

parameters.name: pacId
parameters.description: Specifies the ID of the PAC file for which a new version needs to be created

parameters.name: clonedPacVersion
parameters.description: Specifies the PAC file version that needs to be branched

parameters.name: deleteVersion
parameters.description: Currently, only 10 versions of a PAC file are supported. If this limit is reached and if you are adding a new version using the POST /pacFiles/{pacId}/version/{clonedPacVersion} endpoint, the deleteVersion parameter can be used to specify the PAC file version that must be replaced with the new version created using this request. However, if the limit is reached and if a version is not specified using this parameter, the version with the least number is automatically replaced. If the limit is not reached, this parameter is ignored.

get.description: Retrieves a specific version of a PAC file based on the specified ID

parameters.name: pacId
parameters.description: Specifies the ID of the PAC file

parameters.name: pacVersion
parameters.description: Specifies the version of the PAC file

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Excludes specific information about the PAC file from the response such as the PAC file content

put.description: Performs the specified action on the PAC file version and updates the file status. Supported actions include deploying, staging, unstaging, and marking or unmarking the file as last known good version can be performed on PAC file versions.

parameters.name: pacId
parameters.description: Specifies the ID of the PAC file

parameters.name: pacVersion
parameters.description: Specifies the version of the PAC file

parameters.name: pacVersionAction
parameters.description: Specifies the action that must be performed on the PAC file version

parameters.name: newLKGVer
parameters.description: If you are removing a PAC file version as the last known good version using this request, you need to specify a different version that can be marked as the last known good version.

id.description: The unique identifier for the PAC file

name.description: The name of the PAC file

description.description: The description of the PAC file

domain.description: The domain of your organization to which the PAC file applies

pacUrl.description:
The URL location of the PAC file that is auto-generated when the PAC file is added for the first time.

Note: This value is not required in POST and PUT requests and the value is ignored if present.

pacContent.description: The content of the PAC file. To learn more, see Writing a PAC File.

editable.description:
Indicates whether the PAC file is editable

Note: The Zscaler service provides default PAC files, and admins with sufficient permissions and scope can additionally create and manage their own custom PAC files. To learn more, see Using Default PAC Files to Forward Traffic to ZIA and Using Custom PAC Files to Forward Traffic to ZIA. This field is read-only.

pacSubURL.description: Obfuscated domain name of the organization to which this PAC file applies

pacUrlObfuscated.description: A Boolean value that indicates whether the PAC file URL is obfuscated. If this value is true, the obfuscated URL is returned in the pacSubURL field.

pacVerificationStatus.description: Indicates the verification status of the PAC file and if any errors are identified in the syntax

pacVersionStatus.description: Indicates the status of a specific version of a PAC file as whether it is deployed, staged for deployment, or is marked as the last known good version.

pacVersion.description: The version number of the PAC file

pacCommitMessage.description: The commit message entered while saving the PAC file version as indicated by the pacVersion field

totalHits.description: The number of times the PAC file was used during the last 30 days

lastModificationTime.description: The timestamp when the PAC file was last modified. This value is represented in Unix time.

lastModifiedBy.description: The username of the admin who last modified the PAC file

createTime.description: The timestamp when the PAC file was created. This value is represented in Unix time.

Pac.description: Information about the PAC file along with the PAC file content. To learn more, see Writing a PAC File.

success.description: A Boolean value indicating whether the PAC file validation was successful or not

messages.description: The list of errors and warnings generated as a result of the PAC file validation

warningCount.description: The number of warnings present in the list of messages

errorCount.description: The number of errors present in the list of messages

id.description: A unique identifier for an entity

name.description: The configured name of the entity

externalId.description: An external identifier used for an entity that is managed outside of ZIA. Examples include zpaServerGroup and zpaAppSegments. This field is not applicable to ZIA-managed entities.

EntityReference.description: This is an immutable reference to an entity that mainly consists of id and name

PacValidationMessage.description: Information about the PAC file validation results

severity.description: Indicates the severity of the message. A value of 1 indicates a warning, whereas a value of 2 indicates an error.

endLine.description: Designates the number of the last line to which the messages applies

endColumn.description: Designates the number of the last column to which the messages applies

line.description: Designates the number of the first line to which the messages applies

column.description: Designates the number of the first column to which the messages applies

fatal.description: A Boolean value indicating the PAC file validation completion status. A true value is returned when validation is not completed.
